name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-transcript
title: YouTube Transcript — FlashData
description: YouTube transcript text with timestamps from existing caption tracks. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_transcript access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Read timestamped YouTube transcripts for citations
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].segments. Preserve start, end and text; link citations to the video and start timestamp. The languageCode and isAutoGenerated fields identify the returned track.
dev.flashdata.limits: auto=true selects existing automatically generated captions; it does not run speech recognition. Missing tracks do not fall back to uploader captions or another language.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
